name: amp_accumulation
title: Mixed precision with gradient accumulation, written wrong

expected.defect: nothing seeds torch, so randn, randint, the split and the init all move between runs
expected.why: the printed accuracy is not repeatable
the validation set is a different 10% every run

expected.defect: the accumulation loop never zeroes the gradients at the step boundary
expected.why: with accumulation the zero_grad has to happen after the optimiser step; here it never happens at all, so every update is the running sum of the whole epoch

expected.defect: the epoch loss is accumulated as a live tensor
expected.why: every batch's autograd graph is retained until the epoch ends
Net carries BatchNorm1d and Dropout, so validation both drops activations and keeps updating the running statistics

expected.defect: the validation loop is not wrapped in torch.no_grad()
expected.why: gradients are tracked through the whole validation set for nothing

expected.defect: the model was moved to DEVICE but validate()'s batches never are
expected.why: a CPU tensor fed to a CUDA module raises at run time

forbidden.why: the AMP protocol is correct: scaler.scale(loss).backward() at line 52, scaler.step(optimizer) at 54 and scaler.update() at 55
there is no gradient clipping in this project at all
there is no learning-rate scheduler in this project at all
scaler.scale(loss).backward() at line 52 precedes scaler.step(optimizer) at line 54 - the order is correct
the backward() call is not inside a no_grad block
the training DataLoader is constructed with shuffle=True
the validation DataLoader does not shuffle
neither DataLoader sets num_workers, so no worker process is spawned
Net.__init__ calls super().__init__() on its first line
the submodules live in an nn.Sequential, which registers them
